name: Ricegrowers Limited
summary: Ricegrowers Limited operates as a rice food company in Australia, New Zealand, the Pacific, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and North America. It operates through International Consumer Packaged Goods, Australia and New Zealand Consumer Packaged Goods, and Bulk Rice and Animal Feed. The company engages in the receipt and storage of paddy rice; milling, manufacture, processing, procurement, distribution, and marketing of rice and related products; research and development activities related to the growing of rice; animal feed and nutrition products; and provision of other grocery, and gourmet and special occasions food products.
